name: Archer
overview: Smart-mouthed superspy Sterling Archer and his dysfunctional team of secret agents turn dangerous missions into messy misadventures around the globe.

name: The Archer
overview: Archer champion Lauren Pierce escapes a corrupt juvenile correctional facility with Rebecca, a fierce but alluring inmate. Together they must survive a desperate warden who is bow-hunting his prey to make sure his secret stays buried

name: Archer
overview: Archer is a short-lived American crime drama series starring Brian Keith and John P. Ryan that aired on NBC in 1975.

name: Meet Corliss Archer
overview: Meet Corliss Archer is an American sitcom that aired in syndication from April to December 1954. The series stars Ann Baker in the title role. The program was an adaptation of the radio series of the same name, which was based on a series of short stories by F. Hugh Herbert.

name: Judge Archer
overview: The spear signifies political power, the arrow personal ambition. What happens when the two collide?

name: Miss Archer
overview: Follow Dre, a young woman hired to be a governess, and Albie, the strange boy she is entrusted to raise in an isolated, gothic mansion where all are forced to maintain the illusion that the year is 1884. At first, Dre works hard to embody the role of 'Miss Archer,' with comportment lessons and period-appropriate dresses. But mysteries soon arise, and with each new discovery Dre grows more protective of Albie, who may hold the key to human survival.

name: Archer House
overview: A young outcast braves the petit four-fueled skits and cult-like rituals of a Texas sorority.

name: Archer & Armstrong
overview: An action-adventure/buddy comedy colliding a drunk, delinquent immortal who has given up on saving the world and the idealistic young man who needs him for a globe-trotting quest to stop history's oldest conspiracy.

name: The Archer: Fugitive from the Empire
overview: A rugged warrior is on a quest to avenge his father's brutal slaying and in search of a legendary sorcerer who can help him. Joining him on his mission is a beautiful enchantress who is also searching for the sorcerer; pursuing him is a malevolent wizard who wants him dead.

name: Night of the Archer
overview: An archery contest results in the murder of the rich family head by someone with an arrow. Of course, the roving competitor trying to win the money becomes the chief suspect, despite everyone else there also being archery experts and many of the others being heirs in the dead man's will.

name: The Archer
overview: A hand-drawn animation of the Chinese folktale “Houyi Shoots Down the Suns.”

name: Meet Maxwell Archer
overview: Maxwell Archer, a private detective, attempts to clear a young man wrongly accused of murder.

name: The Green Archer
overview: The struggle over the Bellamy estate ends with Michael Bellamy accused of murder and killed on the way to prison, while his brother Abel Bellamy takes control of the estate for his own nefarious plans.
